## Purpose

- How you've grown
- What's changed in your work
- Patterns across years

## Claude Usage

Claude will populate this when:
- 2+ years of year_end_review data exists
- User requests: "Compare this year to last year"
- Annual synthesis runs with prior year data
- Upload synthesis includes multi-year reviews

This document provides longitudinal perspective on career progression.
